source_text: In Sudan, Sufi tariqas and some Salafi-leaning groups have historically promoted FGM as a sunnah act tied to pre-Islamic Arab customs assimilated into local Islam, with endorsements from certain imams in the 2010s framing it as essential for female piety and marriage eligibility.
